method: Polymarket prices read from the public gamma API (events?slug= and markets list) on 2026-10-31 ~14:55-15:05Z; ask/bid stored for the leg's own outcome (index-1 outcomes mirrored as 1-bid0 / 1-ask0). Anchors: no-vig sportsbook moneylines from bet365 (FOX Sports table, Oct 28), FanDuel Research and DraftKings (SI, Oct 27), RotoWire consensus (Oct 26) and VegasInsider book-by-book (Oct 30, TEN-CIN). Stats per RESEARCH.md from the official NFL Week 8 injury report (nfl.com), RotoWire line-move article (Oct 28), SI/FanDuel previews. Moves capped at 4 points. Caveat: an earlier markets?slug= read returned thin $3k books with 5-7c spreads for the NFL 1pm games; the events?slug= and liquidity-sorted reads show the real books ($100k-$1.1M, 1-2c spreads), so only the latter are used.

legs.label: NFL: Ravens +3.5 at Bills
legs.why: Anchor: FD BUF -3 (-118)/BAL +3 (-104) => BUF covers -3 51.5% no-vig ex-push; with ~9% on exactly 3, P(BUF by 4+) ~46.9% => BAL +3.5 ~53.1%. bet365 Oct 28 BUF -3.5, ML BAL +149/BUF -178 (BAL 38.5% no-vig). Injuries: Lamar Jackson (ankle, out since Wk4 halftime) not on the final report and expected to play (Rapoport); line moved +3.5 -> +3 on that news, so mostly priced. Not a full practice since Wk4 (mobility risk). BAL OUT G Ioane (starting C/G), S Hawkins; BUF OUT WR Shavers, Q WR DJ Moore, TE Kincaid, OT Spencer Brown, CB Alford; S Gardner-Johnson suspended. Efficiency: BUF defense 30th in EPA/play and 30th in success rate allowed (only bottom-3 in both); Lamar 70.8% comp, 6 TD/1 INT, 144 rush yds in 4 games. Situation: BUF 5-1 off a bye; BAL 4-3, two straight division losses incl. 35-13 at CIN with Huntley. Trends: BUF 3-1-1 ATS last 5 H2H (weak). Total 53.5-54.5 (up 3), weather n/a. Net +0.4 for Lamar vs a bottom-3 defense: 53.5% vs ask 54c = -0.5c.

legs.label: NFL: Lions -3.5 vs Vikings
legs.why: Anchor: bet365 (Oct 28) DET -3.5, ML MIN +150/DET -180 => DET 61.6% no-vig; RotoWire consensus DET -3 (-155/+143 => 59.6%). Line opened DET -4.5, fell to -3 despite 63% tickets/82% money on DET, then back to -3.5. A -3.5 line with a ~62% ML puts the cover near 49-50%. Injuries (final report): DET OUT S Kerby Joseph, Q CB McCreary; Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) was Q midweek and is NOT on the final report (playing). MIN: Aaron Jones (knee) was Q midweek, not on final report; only S Jay Ward Q. EPA, last-5 detail n/a (not found within budget). Dome, no weather. 49% vs ask 48c = +1c (below the 3c bar).

legs.label: NFL: Vikings ML at Lions
legs.why: Anchor: bet365 MIN +150/DET -180 => MIN 38.4%; RotoWire consensus +143/-155 => 40.4% (older, Oct 26, before the move back to -3.5). Use the newer 38.4%. Stats as det-m35 (both teams near full health on the final report; DET without S Kerby Joseph). 38.5% vs ask 38c = +0.5c.

legs.label: NFL: Titans ML at Bengals
legs.why: Anchor (VegasInsider Oct 30): FD +570/-820 => TEN 14.4%; bet365 +550/-800 => 14.8%; BetMGM +550/-750; DK/Caesars +490/-675 => 16.3%; sharpest books ~14.5-15%. Line opened CIN -6.5 (+235/-290), now -11.5 to -12.5 after CIN beat BAL 35-13 off the bye. Injuries: TEN OUT RB Spears, WR Carnell Tate, P Townsend; Q WR Calvin Ridley, DL Franklin-Myers, CB Jaylon Jones. CIN OUT S Dugger only. Efficiency: CIN 6th EPA/play, 5th success rate; Burrow 71.7%, 15 TD/3 INT, 7th adj EPA/play. TEN 1-6. Trends: CIN 8-2 ATS last 10 H2H (weak). Total 49.5 -> 46.5. TEN depth losses support the lower end: 14.5% vs ask 14c = +0.5c.

legs.label: NFL: Jets -1.5 vs Raiders

legs.label: CFB: Wisconsin ML at Iowa
legs.why: Anchor: Dimers odds page WISC +122/IOWA -127 => WISC 44.6% no-vig (book unnamed); Dimers model IOWA 58.2%; total 39.5 (low-scoring, more variance toward the dog). QB/injury/efficiency for 2026: n/a (search returned 2024 previews only; not found within the lookup budget). Kickoff 16:00Z, about an hour after research. No move: 44.5% vs ask 45c = -0.5c.

notes: No VALUE legs: every leg is within -1c to +1c of the no-vig anchor on the real Polymarket books. bal-ml|bal-p35 lift 1.8 because a Ravens win always covers +3.5 (exact 0.39/(0.39*0.535)=1.87, rounded down). det-m35|min-ml lift 0 (mutually exclusive). Not boarded: ARI-DAL, CLE-PIT, IND-JAX (books priced at the no-vig line on the thin read; real books not re-read within budget), 4pm NFL games (start ~30.5h out), NBA and tennis (lookup budget spent on NFL). Nothing logged to picks.csv (C1 logs VALUE legs only). Paper only, never revenue. ~37 web lookups.
